$comment: The reviewer registry (shell/docs/decisions/ADR-0013-agent-config-is-the-registry.md): one entry per role, and nothing else restates these fields; when each role runs is the review-loop skill's. A role with an agentFile keeps its instructions, pinned model ID, review header and token slug in that file. A role without one runs a superpowers prompt (instructions), so the controller's dispatch carries its token step, verdicts and headers from here, and model is a family alias. In headers, <model> is 'Claude ' plus the model the reviewer's system prompt names. Private keys: $HOME/.config/gcscode/gcscode-<role>.pem, or $GH_REVIEWER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_DIR/gcscode-<role>.pem. Dispatch, timing and the architect's routing heuristic: the review-loop skill.

extension-architect.routing: heuristic: product spec/ADR PRs that touch extension architecture (review-loop skill); never agentic-process PRs
